vision: Enable ops teams to receive instant incident notifications with SLA timers across integrated platforms, ensuring service reliability and rapid incident resolution within microservice-based systems.
scope: The epic covers real-time incident detection, SLA countdown capabilities, and integration with PagerDuty and Slack. Notifications must trigger within 500ms latency. Out of scope are analytics dashboards and historical SLA reports.
success_criteria: Incident notifications delivered within 500ms to PagerDuty and Slack channels
SLA timers accurately displayed and updated for every incident

user_stories.title: Receive real-time incident notifications within 500ms latency
user_stories.i_want: to receive immediate incident alerts with details in my communication tools
user_stories.so_that: I can respond quickly and reduce downtime during service disruptions

acceptance_criteria.given: an incident occurs in any microservice
acceptance_criteria.then: notifications are delivered to PagerDuty and Slack within 500ms

user_stories.title: Display SLA timers for each active incident
user_stories.i_want: to see live SLA countdowns associated with ongoing incidents
user_stories.so_that: I can monitor response and resolution times against defined SLAs

acceptance_criteria.then: the countdown is visible and updates accurately until resolution

user_stories.title: Integrate real-time notifications with PagerDuty and Slack microservices
user_stories.i_want: to connect the incident notification service to existing PagerDuty and Slack APIs
user_stories.so_that: alerts and SLA updates are reliably broadcast across our operations tools

acceptance_criteria.given: notifications are ready to be sent
acceptance_criteria.when: the integration service triggers the external APIs
acceptance_criteria.then: PagerDuty incidents and Slack messages appear instantly with correct formatting
